plan.title: What changed
items: Your three notes on 1E are in new draft 1F (1D and 1E kept to compare). The storyverse is now the last thing she explains: the mic drop.

plan.title: You decide
items: 'Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go.' still comes after the storyverse line, because it links to the bus. Keep it, or end the speech on the storyverse?
Pick 1F (or note a line). Picking starts the recut: Maddie's new voice, scene A recut, its timeline page, and Premiere sequence A r3.

replies.1-1A-L1: Done in 1D line 1: "He's been playing it on repeat for five years now. Ever since you lot went."
replies.1-1A-L3: Done in 1D line 3: no "he was a materialist"; "He took your materialist science word for word. Built world after world, simulated worlds... in every one of them, something was missing."
replies.1-1A-L4: Done in 1D line 4: "your cartoon, the scientist with the portal gun" and "them films, with that strange bloke in a cape fighting versions of himself" (the Doctor Strange pun, still not naming him), then "checked all of 'em... Still nothing there."
replies.1-1A-L5: Done in 1D line 5: "A photo of your nan is real. It's still her. She's just flattened into two dimensions."
replies.1-1A-L6: Done in 1D line 6: "Same idea for you. You're a projection, in four dimensions, of something bigger."
replies.1-1A-L7: Done in 1D line 7: "Consciousness drives it. You drove it, and now you're gone. And now we've worked all that out... we really feel like we fucked this up." Delivered rueful and honest, not as a gag.
replies.1-1D-L6: Done in new draft 1E, lines 6 and 7: "And there's only one universe. Not loads of copies, where everything happens somewhere else anyway. Just the one. So it really matters. And so did you." Then: "Far as he can tell, the point of it all is consciousness getting to know itself. My boss calls it the storyverse."
replies.1-1E-L5: Done in 1F line 5: "You're real in the same way a photo of your nan is real. It's still her. She's just flattened into two dimensions."
replies.1-1E-L6: Done in 1F line 6, exactly your version: "Same idea for you. You're a projection, in four dimensions, of something bigger. [pause] And there's only one universe. So it really matters. And so did you." The 'not loads of copies' fluff is gone.
replies.1-1E-L7: Done in 1F: the regret now comes straight after 'And so did you', then "Far as he can tell, the point of all of this is consciousness getting to know itself better. Rather than the multiverse... my boss calls it the storyverse." One question: 'Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go.' still follows (the bus link). Keep it after the mic drop, or end on the storyverse?
